_nota: El buceo NO es un portal mas: es una PUERTA CON ESTADO. Los mapas submarinos solo dejan pasar si el personaje ya aprendio la habilidad, y eso se aprende hablando una vez con un entrenador. Hay dos niveles, cada uno con su entrenador y su conjunto de mapas. Los textos y los ids de dialogo estan MEDIDOS en la captura de Celestia del 23/09/2026 (sesion mundo_165638) y cruzados con msg.xml del cliente, que da el texto exacto. Los dos flags hay que guardarlos en el personaje, como se hizo con hablo_michael.

textos.70141: At the end of the beach is a shallow sea area. But you cannot go much further unless you are good at diving... You'd better learn basic Diving Skills from a [Diving Trainer]! A trainer called [Nila] was seen on the [Golden Beach] not long ago. Go and see!
textos.70415: I am Basic Diving Coach Nira in charge of training adventurers. Have you come here to learn the [Diving Skill]?
textos.70418: No problem, let's begin our lessons! Come on!
textos.70419: After several hours of hard training, you have finally learned the [Neritic Diving Skill]!
textos.70420: Great! Your learning ability and physical strength are both excellent. From now on, you can [feel safe in shallow sea.]
textos.70421: Your learning ability is strong. You are now able to feel safe in shallow sea. I cannot teach you any more. If you want to learn Abyssal Diving Skill, why not find my brother [Dipsey Hunter] in the [Blue Sea].

niveles._medido: Los siete ids salen de la captura; los textos, de msg.xml. El 70421 es el que sale cuando YA se tiene la habilidad: es el de 'no te puedo ensenar mas'. El 70420 es el de recien aprendida.

Los ids salen de la captura (sesion mundo_170542) y los textos de msg.xml. El 70615 es la rama de RECHAZO y lleva al 70616, que te echa. El 70621 sale cuando ya tienes la habilidad. Todavia no se sabe que mapas abre este segundo nivel.

textos.70613: Well done, dude! You must have learned Diving Skill from my younger brother so you can dive here using simple equipment. The stance and tools are similar too.
textos.70614: I want to learn the Abyssal Diving Skill.
textos.70615: You don't need to know who I learned from.
textos.70616: Hey man, I gave you such a warm greeting. But your cool response really cut me. ... Just go away, and don't bother me again.
textos.70617: What! You wanna be extreme too! Great! Since you have interest and are my brother's student, I will give you the real no holds barred training. ...
textos.70618: After half-day of exhaustive training, you have learned all of the Diving Skills from Dipsey Hunter
textos.70619: Dude, you were totally born to dive! There's nothing more I can teach you. ... Now dive down deep in the ocean and see what she is hiding down there.
textos.70621: Gee, you have mastered all of the Abyssal Diving Skills. Why didn't you tell me earlier. I guess it doesn't really matter. You need to pay me now.

pendiente: El usuario dijo que hay TRES mapas que obligan a bajar; de momento solo tenemos Colorful Coral Reefs (85). Faltan los otros dos y el segundo nivel entero.
